o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دوریمك (dörẹmek), دورومك (dörümek) Proto-Turkic *törü- (“to be born, originate”), ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *töŕ. Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (törü-, “to come into being, to be generated”), Turkish türemek, Gagauz türümää, Turkmen döremek.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كشور (käşür), from Early Old Oghuz كَشُرْ (käşür), from Classical Persian گَزَر (gazar). Compare Turkish keşir, Turkmen kǟşir.
Literally, “may I be sacrificed for you”. Calque of Persian قربانت بروم (qorbânat beravam).

From Arabic سُنَّة (sunna).
Doublet of sünnət
